comment: We got 4 pages of notes for the final and 2 front and back for the other two tests. God bless

Dr. Croushore was solid. He is easy to reach and very knowledgeable as he worked at the Fed for several years. His lectures can be slow at times, but it is obvious he enjoys teaching. My main piece of advice would be to read the textbook in prep for exams as it gives concrete logic for curve shifts.

Super smart, worked for the Fed so he'll connect a lot of what you learn in class to the Fed which was super interesting. He always starts class with current events and in general, this class helps you keep up with what's going on. Very lecture-heavy but assignments are easy and helpful to understand what he's teaching. 10/10 recommend
Croushore was always so excited about class and I found it super inspiring. I also found the course to be super practical and really enjoyed it
Expects you to learn everything from the book (his book). Has no structure to teaching in class. The things aren't reinforced at all until the test comes (no quizes)

Smart guy- knows his stuff, but won't teach. Expects you to read the textbook he wrote and just learn by yourself while literally all he does in class is talk about current events and news. This course was definitely a self-teach class. Tests are tricky.
Brilliant guy and a great professor. Homework is easily manageable, his tests are a bit tricky most of the time but does a great job explaining things in class. Would definitely recommend

Great Professor.  Really knows what he is talking about and has a lot of experience.  Boring at times but you can tell he is very passionate.  Not too much work either just weekly online quizes and very fair tests.  He has really inspired me to look more into economics.

Crystal clear, very smart, former Fed Banker.  He is the best econ professor at Richmond.  Not the easiest class in the world, but if you go and actually do the needed materials, you will do well.  Great professor!!

Fantastic teacher. He knows this stuff better than anybody I've ever met, but what do you expect of the ex-Vice President of the Philly Fed. A little boring at times, but an incredibly nice guy that will work with you. If you do the required (but not checked) reading/hw, you will do well.
Croushore is awesome! It is impossible not to do well in his class unless you seriously slack. He is an expert in his field and is a great contact. He goes the extra mile for all his students.

extremely knowledgable, A LOT of reading to do for everyday. Overall a very nice guy, Highly recommended for someone who really wants to learn his stuff well. BEWARE: if you don't do the HW, you will pretty much fail him  or leave unsatisfied.

Wow this guy sucks! He is so boring and the Money and Banking class I took was so hard.  He worked for the Fed and is real knowledgeable but his teacher sucks and it is real hard to do well. Take him only if ur hihgly interested
